6: And know, that there are twelve tribes, corresponding to the twelve constellations of the Zodiac. Every tribe has its own unique liturgy (nusach), and their own unique gate through which their prayers enter, and each tribe awakens through their prayer the power of their particular constellation of the twelve in the zodiac, and their constellation shines back down and causes vegetation to grow, along with whatever else is needed.

And this is the explanation of, "A star emerges from Jacob, a tribe stands up out of Israel." "Stands up" - this is the aspect of Amidah (standing), the aspect of prayer; for when a Jew stands in prayer, through this it awakens the star, and the star encourages and forces things to grow, as the sages have said: there is no blade of grass below that does not have its own star and angel above, that strike it and say to it: Grow!
